status: Local current-source disclosure draft; not a live App Store Connect attestation

collected_data.label: Name
collected_data.basis: Named aircraft owners/pilots in shared flight records and operator-sent support correspondence.

collected_data.label: Email Address
collected_data.basis: Provider sign-in through the embedded service browser and email sent by the operator to support; no claim that email is required for local reception.

collected_data.label: Precise Location
collected_data.basis: Configured operator position, aircraft tracks, geotagged clues and embedded media coordinates sent to selected services.

collected_data.label: User ID
collected_data.basis: Account IDs, usernames and pilot callsigns used by optional authenticated services and associated operational records.

collected_data.label: Device ID
collected_data.basis: Stable app-install/device-zone identity, enrolled device identity and operational device name.

collected_data.label: Photos or Videos
collected_data.basis: Tracker catalog thumbnails, selected CalTopo photo clues, authorized remote media and recording-file transfers; not only locally processed imagery.

collected_data.label: Audio Data
collected_data.basis: Controller-source audio can be retained in a recording file transferred to the tracker/requester. Live-only VoIP transport alone is not the basis for retained-audio disclosure.

collected_data.label: Other User Content
collected_data.basis: Operational organization/aircraft descriptions, annotations, selected configuration and other incident records sent through configured sharing.

collected_data.label: Product Interaction
collected_data.basis: Tracker-retained session, viewing/transfer request, approval and operational usage events used for authorization and service operation.

collected_data.label: Performance Data
collected_data.basis: Link/route/bandwidth estimates retained with service requests and timing/frame/drop/performance measurements in operator-shared diagnostics.

collected_data.label: Other Diagnostic Data
collected_data.basis: Selected diagnostic bundles and configured service troubleshooting state, including device/OS/network and operational status.

collected_data.label: Customer Support
collected_data.basis: Operator-sent diagnostic attachments and problem descriptions received by support; conservatively disclosed rather than relying on the optional-feedback exception.

local_processing: On-device-only decoding, analysis, reconstruction and caching are not independently treated as developer collection. Configured previews, publication, transfers and support sharing are assessed separately.
